name: Fidelity
overview: The Scriptures emphasize fidelity as a vital expression of faithfulness, especially within marriage and daily conduct. Luke 16:18 highlights the seriousness of marital faithfulness by condemning adultery in the context of divorce and remarriage, while Hebrews 13:4 affirms the honor of an undefiled marriage bed and warns of God's judgment on adulterers. Titus 2:10 extends the call to fidelity beyond marriage, urging believers to demonstrate sincere faithfulness in all things as a testimony that adorns the doctrine of God our Savior.
